scope: local consumer boundaries, not independent cross-owner acceptance

boundaries.contract: Owner delegates first_less/first_greater on [left,right) when lower_index exists; otherwise ascending scan normalizes low/high and applies strict comparison. OA34 uses exact lower time, unchanged Decimal normalization and only direction-sensitive comparison flag. Indexed path equivalence is not a new runtime assertion. Physical identity is integer First/Break.

OA19 caches exact tuple or None using threshold in key; OA20 canonical geometry threshold and initial native prefix filter are separate from blocked-First skipping. OA34 requests strict confirmation but does not independently enforce it on returned native candidate. OA31 can independently relabel B anchors even with null stop/direct; removes causeless rows and invalidates caches conditionally.

OA01 checks parentType, postBehaviorType, anchorBehaviorType in order against either primary prefix, each source key independent; deep-copy and ordered equality dedup. OA26 indexes published row; OA28 invalidates carried result and creation state only. Registration and reconciliation are not transactions.

Pipeline commit callback picks PL registration for bullish else PH, then prepares OrderAudit. Final resolver and reconciliation wrapper likewise chosen by direction; reconcile receives resolved points through market end index before later audit preparation. These are source-traced call boundaries, not complete cross-owner validation.
